sentences.en: Public opinion polls are barometers of confidence in the government.
sentences.zh: 民意调查是衡量政府信任度的晴雨表。

sentences.en: He is seriously competing with her in the polling score.
sentences.zh: 他在民调中与她竞争得很激烈。

sentences.en: The results of our opinion poll permit some interesting conclusions.
sentences.zh: 我们的民意调查显示了一些有趣的结论。
